scope: Departure-specific identifiability of fixed final coefficient2 and original-ranking paired-release noise conditioning; no arrays, held departure labels, predictions, model inference or new score read. Existing metadata only plus prior all-column audit. Root closed further generator numerical search absent a new observable.

novelty.method: Capped incremental research index, then cited source/report inspection; no exhaustive absence claim.
novelty.prior_closed: Naive label-preserving jitter averaging, original FPL phase feature screen and same-flight NM endpoint-error proxy. These do not test the conditional original-ranking estimator using a second release.
novelty.new_but_not_prioritized: A second release can in principle condition original-release endpoint noise; its required departure phase and baseline-error assumptions are unverified, and its ideal noise-only scale is far below target gap.

departure_observability.independent_all30_columns_audit: Only MVT_TIME changes in DEP. BLOCK and TAXITIME are NULL in both. All remaining source fields, including schedule and six FPL clocks, agree.
departure_observability.duplicate_endpoint_limitation: The prior paired-endpoint audit has zero disagreements for duplicate FPL endpoint fields; these are plan/NM estimates, not a duplicate released hidden departure block.

footer_metadata_inspected.both: Only ARROW:schema metadata (2744 bytes), identical30field schema; no export noise seed/generator/phase policy.

departure_observability.counterexamples: Holding every observed DEP field fixed, hidden block may change by -dt (coefficient2), 0 (coefficient1), or +dt (coefficient0). Existing observations cannot distinguish these.
departure_observability.decisive_missing_observable: Authoritative phase-neutral export/noise generator or genuine paired departure block/target observations. No such source was found in local provenance; no repeat network search performed.

original_ranking_conditioning.notation: old takeoff=t+eps_old; final takeoff=t+eps_new; dt=eps_new-eps_old. If hidden block shifts oppositely, old departure target=y_latent+2eps_old.
original_ranking_conditioning.sufficient_assumptions: Centered jointly sign-symmetric iid release errors independent of latent flight quantities imply E[eps_old|dt]=-dt/2. Generic iid alone is insufficient.
original_ranking_conditioning.iid_counterexample: For independent Exp(1)-1 errors, E[eps_old|dt=d]=-0.5+max(-d,0), not -d/2.
original_ranking_conditioning.baseline_caveat: pipeline/common.py:build_features already includes original movement minus schedule/LOBT/IOBT/EOBT1/AOBT3 plus calendar; other selected components also use original clocks. Thus -dt is not automatically an innovation relative to v80.
original_ranking_conditioning.conditional_innovation: Even assuming phase symmetry, compare E[y_old|old_inputs,final_time] to E[y_old|old_inputs], rather than adding an unconditional noise correction. There may also be a changed latent-time posterior. No such v80 residual dependence was established.

conditional_scale_calculation.qualification: Conditional centered symmetric iid noise-only calculations, not actual v80 improvements or universal upper bounds. Baseline errors need not be independent of perturbations.

decision: Preserve current final transform as explicitly conditional. No new candidate, score, departure generator scan, coefficient sweep or registry entry. Reopen only with a genuinely new departure observable/provenance source.
